topic: My toddler keeps getting out of bed at bedtime
video_title: Toddler keeps getting out of bed? What to do tonight (2-5 yrs)
caption:
My toddler keeps getting out of bed at bedtime, and I don't know what else to try.

After a move to a big bed, many kids (2-4 years) pop out again and again. It's common, not a parenting failure.
Set one rule: once it's sleep time, everyone stays in bed until morning.
Walk your child back calmly, without lecturing. Keep it short and boring.
In the morning, praise them for staying in bed.
